description: This file defines the AnimatorPath class which manages a sequence of PathPoint objects, allowing movement, line creation, and curve addition for animation paths, indicating it's part of a graphical or animation feature in an Android app.

classes.name: AnimatorPath
classes.description: A class that manages a list of PathPoint objects to define an animated path with methods to move to points, draw lines, and curves.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Adds a move command to the path at specified (x, y) coordinates, creating a discontinuity if not the first point.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Adds a line segment from the current point to the specified (x, y) coordinates.

methods.name: curveTo
methods.description: Adds a quadratic Bézier curve from the current point to (x, y) with specified control points.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Returns a collection of all PathPoint objects that make up the path.
